chip.description: Two-channel PCM sample player addressing up to 128 KB of sample ROM, with a per-voice bank output (taxonomy §4.14 example).
chip.notes: MAME 0.288 device k007232, full name "Konami 007232 PCM Controller" (src/devices/sound/k007232.cpp; 17-bit sample address bus, bank-switchable per voice).
